name: Arcturus Defense Solutions OmniStrike TAC-8 Overlay
description:
The OmniStrike TAC-8 is Arcturus Defense Solutions' flagship tactical overlay system, engineered for theater-level commanders and elite special operations units requiring simultaneous processing of up to eight distinct battlefield data streams. At its core lies a dual-lattice neurosynaptic co-processor bonded directly to the prefrontal and parietal cortices, enabling real-time fusion of drone telemetry, satellite imagery, squad biometrics, enemy electronic signatures, munitions tracking, comms intercepts, environmental sensor arrays, and allied unit positioning — all rendered as a coherent, layered AR battlefield gestalt without cognitive overload. The hardware is encased in a full cranial Faraday mesh rated to MIL-SPEC EMP-9 standards, surviving direct proximity detonation of Class-IV EMP grenades. Quantum-encrypted uplinks operating on the ADS-Q7 protocol provide tamper-proof communications with command infrastructure, Iowan Behemoth autonomous combat platforms, and theater AI coordination nodes.

Among the upper echelons of Meridian 88's military-industrial complex, the TAC-8 is spoken of in reverent, almost mythological terms — operators who carry it are called 'Eightfold' in field slang, a nod to the unit's eight-stream capacity and the near-prescient situational awareness it confers. The psychological weight of commanding Iowan Behemoths directly through neural impulse — feeling the thunderous feedback of a forty-ton war machine as an extension of one's own limbs — is described by veterans as both intoxicating and deeply alienating. Psychiatric discharge rates among long-term TAC-8 operators run at three times the baseline for augmented soldiers, a statistic Arcturus Defense Solutions disputes vigorously in its public filings.
installation_requirements: Level 5 neuro-surgical facility; minimum 72-hour calibration protocol; ADS-certified neurotechnician; full cranial Faraday mesh installation prior to unit bonding; psychological pre-screening mandatory per ADS MedOps Directive 7-C
rejection_risk: Low (4%) with proper pre-surgical immunosuppression regimen; elevated to 18% if Faraday mesh is third-party non-ADS certified
maintenance: Quarterly ADS-certified firmware patch via secure uplink; annual hardware inspection at licensed ADS depot; co-processor thermal paste replacement every 18 months

side_effects: Chronic multi-stream echo syndrome: residual phantom data overlays persist during off-duty periods, most commonly manifesting as translucent positional markers superimposed on civilian environments
Dissociative automaton bleed: extended Behemoth control sessions cause operators to briefly experience proprioceptive confusion between their biological body and the last controlled machine frame
Sleep architecture fragmentation: REM cycles interrupted by involuntary tactical processing loops, resulting in non-restorative sleep without pharmaceutical intervention

Emotional blunting in high-data environments: the co-processor's cognitive load-balancing suppresses limbic activity during eight-stream operation, with partial persistence post-session in long-term users
cultural_context: The OmniStrike TAC-8 has become a cultural signifier of absolute military authority within Meridian 88's armed forces and the private military contractor ecosystem. Soldiers who bear it are rarely seen in civilian spaces — the unit's bulk and the subtle cranial scarring of its installation are immediately recognizable, and in some districts inspire a mixture of awe and unease. Anti-augmentation activist groups have specifically named the TAC-8 in their literature as emblematic of the 'machine-soldier convergence,' arguing that direct neural control of autonomous killing platforms like Iowan Behemoths erases the last meaningful ethical boundary between human combatant and weapon system.
known_users: Select Tessera Corponation black-site security directors
story_hooks: A decommissioned TAC-8 unit surfaces on the black market still carrying encrypted ghost-data from its previous operator's final mission — a mission officially classified as never having occurred. Someone very powerful wants it back.

An Eightfold operator begins experiencing tactical overlays that do not correspond to any known battlefield or data source — the imagery is of locations that will burn in three days, and she cannot determine if her implant is malfunctioning or receiving a signal from something that shouldn't exist.

A Tessera Corponation executive is found dead, their personal security TAC-8 operator standing motionless over the body in a dissociative state — the operator's implant logs show the Behemoth they were controlling remotely was given orders from a second, unregistered neural signature.
